# Barney Pullen

## Overview

- **Age:** Twenty years old as of Volume 1  <sub>[v1 c16 P28](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0028)</sub>
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v1 c13 P2](../source/v01-c13.md#nw-v01-c13-p0002), [v1 c16 P28](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0028)</sub>
- **Status:** Married  <sub>[v3 c1 P0](../source/v03-c01.md#nw-v03-c01-p0000)</sub>
- **Origin:** Brierley  <sub>[v1 c1 P2](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0002), [v1 c13 P2](../source/v01-c13.md#nw-v01-c13-p0002)</sub>
- **Role:** Farmer  <sub>[v3 c1 P15](../source/v03-c01.md#nw-v03-c01-p0015)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Barnard  <sub>[v3 c8 P5](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0005)</sub>

## Appearance

Barney is a large, stout, twenty-year-old young man with a round, expressionless face and a freckled complexion.

_Sources: [v1 c16 P28](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0028), [v1 c17 P20](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0020)_

## Personality

He is exceedingly shy, quiet, and possesses an agonizing inability to hold a conversation. Despite his awkwardness, he has a pleasant and cheerful nature, often smirking and laughing softly without knowing what to say. He is timid around women and lacks the courage to court directly, but he is persistent when he sets his mind on getting married. He is an industrious and reliable worker.

_Sources: [v1 c16 P28](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0028), [v3 c8 P5](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0005), [v3 c8 P15](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0015)_

- To marry and establish a home on his farm  <sub>[v3 c8 P5](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0005)</sub>

## History

Barney Pullen grew up in Brierley as part of the Gorham Pullen family. During the Brierley Sunday-school picnic, he ferried attendees on the Lake of Glassy Waters and saved his sister Odette from drowning when she fell over. He later drove Nell Harcourt and Isolde Pembroke to the Sunday-school concert. As he grew older, he developed a deep crush on Nell Harcourt. Lacking the courage to propose in person, he persuaded his sister Odette to propose to Nell on his behalf after his father gave him the upper farm. After Nell rejected the proposal, he pursued and married Nettie Scobie.

_Sources: [v1 c13 P2](../source/v01-c13.md#nw-v01-c13-p0002), [v1 c14 P68](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0068), [v1 c16 P28](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0028), [v3 c1 P0](../source/v03-c01.md#nw-v03-c01-p0000), [v3 c8 P5](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0005), [v3 c8 P15](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0015), [v3 c8 P22](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0022)_
